recipes.name: Baked Doughnuts Three Ways
ingredients: 1/3 cup (71g) light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, packed
1/2 to 1 teaspoon ground nutmeg, to taste
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
2 2/3 cups (320g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Birthday Cake Ice Cream
ingredients: 2 cups (about 150g) diced yellow cake, such Classic Birthday Cake, Back-to-Basics Yellow Cake, or Classic Yellow Cake*

recipes.name: Buttermilk Pancake Crêpes
ingredients: 2 cups (220g) King Arthur Buttermilk Pancake Mix
12-ounce bag fresh cranberries, or 3 1/2 cups (347g) fresh or frozen cranberries
zest and juice of 1 medium orange
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract

recipes.name: Chilindrinas
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
2 3/4 cups (330g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
2 large eggs, plus 1 egg yolk, white reserved
2 teaspoons Mexican vanilla extract, or your favorite vanilla extract
1 1/2 teaspoons Mexican vanilla extract, or your favorite vanilla extract
2/3 cup plus 3 tablespoons (103g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
1 large egg white, reserved from above

recipes.name: Chocolate Cookies
yield: 1 1/2 to 2 1/2 dozen cookies, depending on add-ins
ingredients: 1/3 cup (71g) light brown sugar or dark brown sugar, packed
1/3 cup (28g) Dutch-process cocoa or King Arthur Triple Cocoa Blend
1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
2 tablespoons (28g) milk, (optional, if you add chips/nuts/fruit)
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons (134g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 teaspoon espresso powder, optional; for depth of flavor
2 cups (227g to 340g) chips, nuts, and/or dried fruit, optional but good

recipes.name: Cinnamon Snails
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups (180g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
16 tablespoons (227g) unsalted butter, cold, cut into pats

recipes.name: Crisp Molasses Cookies
ingredients: 1/4 cup (53g) coconut oil or 4 tablespoons (57g) butter, at room temperature
2 cups (240g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Giant Strawberry Shortcake
ingredients: 2 cups plus 2 tablespoons (255g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour*
2/3 cup (152g) heavy cream, cold, plus 1 1/2 tablespoons (21g) for brushing
3/4 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1 1/2 tablespoons (21g) coarse sparkling sugar, for sprinkling
1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/2 teaspoon vanilla bean paste or King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Bacon-Cheddar-Chive Scones
ingredients: 2 cups (240g) King Arthur Gluten-Free Measure for Measure Flour
4 tablespoons (57g) butter, cold; cut into 1/2" pieces
1 cup (113g) cheddar cheese, very coarsely grated or diced
1/3 cup (about 14g) snipped fresh chives or 1/3 cup (21g) finely chopped scallion tops
1/2 pound (227g) bacon, cooked, cooled, and crumbled (about 1 cup)
1 cup (227g) heavy cream or whipping cream, or enough to make the dough cohesive

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Peach Cobbler made with baking mix
ingredients: 1 cup (120g) King Arthur Gluten-Free All-Purpose Biscuit & Baking Mix
2 1/2 cups (425g) fresh or frozen peaches (about 3 or 4 peaches)
1/2 teaspoon cinnamon or 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg, optional

recipes.name: Gluten-Free Sandwich Bread
ingredients: 3 cups (468g) King Arthur Gluten-Free All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Golden Chocolate Chip Muffins
ingredients: 1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
2 cups (227g) King Arthur Golden Wheat Flour

recipes.name: Lighter Than Air Parmesan Puffs
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper, or a couple of dashes Tabasco sauce
1 cup (120g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Make-Ahead Gravy
ingredients: 4 cups (908g) best-quality chicken or turkey stock, homemade or store-bought
6 tablespoons (45g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour or King Arthur Gluten-Free Measure for Measure Flour

recipes.name: Maple Doughnuts
ingredients: 3/4 cup (90g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Mocha Pound Cake
ingredients: 2 teaspoons King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
2 cups (240g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Neapolitan-Style Pizza Crust
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon instant yeast or active dry yeast

recipes.name: Pizza Crust
yield: 1 or 2 standard round pizzas, or 1 large rectangular pizza, about 12 servings
ingredients: 2 teaspoons active dry yeast or instant yeast
3 cups (360g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour

recipes.name: Savory Masa Harina Waffles
yield: 4 1/2 large (7") Belgian waffles; or 5 medium (5") square American-style waffles
ingredients: 1/2 small red onion, peeled and finely diced (about 1/3 cup)

recipes.name: Soft Golden Rolls & Buns
ingredients: 1 package (453g) King Arthur Soft Golden Roll & Bun Mix Kit
yeast packet, included with the mix
1 1/3 cups (303g) milk, hot (120°F to 130°F), plus more as needed*

recipes.name: Sourdough Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: 1/2 cup (113g) ripe (fed) sourdough starter or 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon (135g) sourdough discard
2 teaspoons King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/2 cup plus 2 tablespoons (75g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
3/4 cup (90g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
flaky sea salt, to garnish; optional

recipes.name: Sourdough Milk Bread
ingredients: 1 large egg yolk, white reserved for egg wash
1 cup plus 2 tablespoons (250g) ripe sourdough starter
2 1/2 cups (300g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour

recipes.name: Stuffed Bagel Buns
ingredients: 4 cups (480g) King Arthur Unbleached Bread Flour
3 tablespoons (27g) non-diastatic malt powder or 2 tablespoons (26g) light brown sugar
1/4 cup (28g) King Arthur Better Cheddar Cheese Powder, optional, for enhanced flavor
2 tablespoons (14g) King Arthur Better Cheddar Cheese Powder, optional, for enhanced flavor
1/3 cup (13g) chives or parsley, or other fresh herbs, optional
2 tablespoons (18g) non-diastatic malt powder or 1 tablespoon (13g) light brown sugar

recipes.name: Walnut Bread
ingredients: 1/4 cup (50g) olive oil, or walnut oil
6 cups (720g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour, divided
2 cups (227g) walnut pieces, toasted until lightly browned

recipes.name: Warm Strawberry Puff
yield: one 8" puff, 1 to 3 servings (this is easily doubled)
ingredients: 1 teaspoon King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract
1/3 cup (39g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
1 tablespoon (21g) light corn syrup or dark corn syrup
2 cups (333g) strawberries, washed, trimmed of their leaves and sliced in half
1 to 2 tablespoons (14g to 28g) crème fraîche or sour cream, for topping
